name: Conversor de Base Numérica
tagline: Converta entre binário, octal, decimal e hexadecimal
description: Convert integers between bases 2 through 64, including binary, octal, decimal, hex, Base58, and Base64. Uses BigInt for unlimited precision. Shows formatted output with nibble/byte spacing.
metaTitle: Conversor de Base Numérica – Conversor Online de Binário e Hexadecimal
metaDescription: Conversão entre bases numéricas 2–64. Binário, octal, decimal, hexadecimal, Base58 e muito mais.
